text:
Harper Lane: Alert  Incident in infra is impacting the demo fleet. PMs recommend delaying tomorrow's launch by 1 hour. Need comms plan for press + customers.

Eli Wood: Confirmed. Site reliability team reports degraded scheduler causing pod restarts. ETA for mitigation ~45m. We should assume embargo needs to move.

Marina Cruz: Ok. If we delay, we must notify press immediately and update the blog top note. Do we push an immediate advisory or wait until we have a firm new time?

Harper Lane: Recommend immediate advisory: brief note that launch is delayed ~1 hour due to technical issue; updated timeline to follow. Keeps outlets from posting inaccurate coverage.

Dylan Shaw: LegalBot  any issues with sending an early delay advisory? Keep it factual.

LegalBot: No problem. Use neutral language: "postponed due to technical issue; new time pending." Avoid speculative causes. We also need to include contact for embargo questions. Clearance: approved for send.

PressOps Bot: Draft advisory ready. ETA to send: immediate once Harper approves. I can schedule a follow-up advisory with revised embargo once Ops confirms new lift time.

Harper Lane: Send the advisory now. Use subject: "Launch timing update (short delay)". Include exec contact and link to status page.

PressOps Bot: Sent advisory to full media list at 2026-10-02T09:15:00-07:00. Holding follow-up advisory slot. :white_check_mark:

Marina Cruz: SocialBot please pause scheduled promos and hold paid amplification until we confirm new time. Also add a pinned note on the blog with the delay.

SocialBot: Pausing scheduled posts and paid boosts now. Will hold until manual resume. :pause_button:

Eli Wood: OpsBot  can you give a go/no-go ETA and confirm when pod restarts finish? We need a precise embargo lift to set next advisory.

OpsBot: Mitigation in progress. Expected stabilization in ~35 minutes. I will post confirmation here when complete and provide a recommended 30-min buffer before lift.

Dylan Shaw: Execs will want a one-line holding statement. Harper, draft please  keep it short and non-technical.

Harper Lane: Draft: "We're postponing today's launch by approximately one hour to ensure a reliable experience for customers. We'll publish an updated schedule shortly and appreciate your patience." Legal ok?

LegalBot: Language ok. Slight tweak: replace "approximately" with "about". Clearance given.

Harper Lane: Updated: "We're postponing today's launch by about one hour to ensure a reliable experience for customers. We'll publish an updated schedule shortly and appreciate your patience." Posting as exec holding line.

Marina Cruz: I'll add that to the blog top-note and to the press advisory thread. Also updating the press kit with a timestamped changelog so outlets know the latest asset version.

PressOps Bot: Noted. I'll resend updated assets after Ops gives new lift time. Also adding a flag: "do not publish until updated advisory lift time".

Eli Wood: Stabilization progress: pod restarts reduced, scheduler patch applied. Monitoring for next 10m. If stable, recommend lift at +60m from now to allow full warmup.

Harper Lane: Sounds good. Plan: advisory sent (done), exec holding line posted, social paused, blog note added. Once OpsBot confirms stable, PressOps Bot to send new advisory with embargo lift +1 hour from now.

OpsBot: Systems stable at 09:42 PT. Recommend embargo lift at 10:30 PT (60m buffer). Will run a final check at 10:00 PT for user-facing endpoints.

PressOps Bot: Scheduling updated advisory for 2026-10-02T10:30:00-07:00. Preparing resend to top-tier outlets with subject "updated embargo lift: 10:30 PT". Will include exec quote and link to full blog.

Marina Cruz: Social plan: primary tweet at 10:35 PT, LinkedIn at 10:45 PT. We'll add pinned reply linking to methodology and changelog. SocialBot, confirm you can resume at those times.

SocialBot: Affirmative. Will resume scheduled posts at confirmed times. Paid boosts will start at +30m after post by default unless manual hold.

Dylan Shaw: Customer comms  send a short email to early-access customers explaining brief delay + reassure production unaffected. CSMs to be on standby for media/customer asks.

Harper Lane: Draft email: "We experienced a brief issue with our demo fleet and have postponed the public launch to 10:30 PT to ensure reliability. Production services unaffected. Please reply if you need help." Approved?

LegalBot: Email wording fine. Add support link and account manager contact.

Marina Cruz: Done. Email queued for 10:00 PT to early-access customers and partner account leads.

Eli Wood: Final ops note: we'll re-run a warm-up sequence at 10:00 PT and verify latency baselines. Will post metrics in this thread.

OpsBot: Warm-up complete at 10:08 PT. Latency baselines within expected range. Final check ok for lift at 10:30 PT.

PressOps Bot: Updated advisory sent to media at 10:30 PT with embargo lift and press kit link. Journalists on the top-tier list were also notified directly via email.

Marina Cruz: Blog updated with final note and changelog entry showing delay + incident summary link. Added timestamp and Legal-approved note.

SocialBot: Posted primary tweet at 10:35 PT and LinkedIn at 10:45 PT. Paid amplification scheduled to start at 11:05 PT unless paused.

Dylan Shaw: Support and CSMs reporting minor inbound questions; no major issues. Everyone set on standby for press follow-ups.

Harper Lane: Big thanks team  smooth handling. Keep monitoring for any post-launch chatter and escalate to execs if coverage crosses threshold.

PressOps Bot: Closing checklist: advisory sent, assets updated, blog note posted, social posted, customer email sent, ops verified. Monitoring ongoing. :white_check_mark:
